outcome: Excessive hemorrhage during management of cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 120 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy: 40 who experienced excessive bleeding and 80 controls without severe hemorrhage
finding: Increased gestational mass size and PSV were risk factors for hemorrhage during management of cesarean scar pregnancy, while increased uterine scar thickness and RI were protective factors.
gest_age: Case group: 74.1±23.6 days, Control group: not reported
